nodes.label: Option B - Turn-based Booking (Rotating Order)
nodes.rationale: Rotating published order kills the opening sprint and is explainable in one line; rotation is the fairness engine - everyone passes through both front and back of the queue across cycles, with a reversing snake variant per round. Trade-offs: elapsed time (12 people x 24h windows is nearly two weeks); losing still happens within a cycle since rotation compensates only across cycles; a turn can land badly on leave or clinical days; the process needs chasing when turns stall. Flagged by the author as an immediate stopgap because it needs nothing new.
